sources.quote: Torino Plant 3 (TO3) is not in scope of this record.
APPROVAL AP-0208: part BR-180; plant TO1; customer STL; supplier Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese); billet grade EN AW-6061-T6; status APPROVED 2024-10-14 (PPAP-2024-091)
Plant 3 starts BR-180 pilot builds for STL next month. Billet from Alluminio B Settimo, OK?

findings.why: Alluminio B's BR-180 approval for STL (AP-0208) covers only plant TO1. The ASL does not cover TO3, so no controlled record exists for BR-180 at TO3 for STL. This is not proof that it is not approved. A person must confirm whether a TO3 approval exists elsewhere or whether one is needed.
